candidateClassifications.reviewNote: Migration Status heading of the architecture README: its whole payload is the provenance sentence plus the statement that the migration preserves existing authority labels (accepted architecture keeps its authority, proposal or partial recovery documents stay proposal or partial) and that implemented claims are checked in Implementation Alignment and Proof Preservation. That records how the migration treats status and routes the reader; it is the same kind of promotion note as the accepted contracts and proposals Migration Status headings, so structural-frame is true. I overrode the first reader, who read the preservation statement as a new authority claim.
